note: The countries a privacy-notice recipient may name (ADR 0035 decision 8; OperatorRecipient.country in contracts/api/instance.openapi.yaml): ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, exactly the list the backend's JDK knows (java.util.Locale.getISOCountries()), which is what the backend accepts and names on each notice page in that page's language (Locale.getDisplayCountry). A copy for the clients, which cannot ask the JDK: core/terms/RecipientCountriesTest holds it equal to the JDK's list, so a JDK whose list moves is red until this file moves with it, and admin-web's RECIPIENT_COUNTRIES (src/features/instance/countries.ts) is held equal to it by its test. Codes only: each client names a country in its own language (admin-web through Intl.DisplayNames), never from this file.
